qe: Which Article of the Constitution deals with the 'Appointment of Governor'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Appointment. \n2. Logic: 153 kehta hai ki har state ka ek Governor hoga, par 155 batata hai ki use 'President' appoint karega. \n3. Extra Fact: Governor ko 'Nominated' mana jata hai, elected nahi.

qe: Who was the 'First Governor' of Bihar after Independence?
e: 1. Bihar History: 15 August 1947 ko Jairamdas Daulatram ne pad sambhala tha. \n2. Fact: Zakir Hussain Bihar ke aise Governor the jo baad mein Bharat ke President bane.

qe: The 'Pardoning Power' (क्षमादान शक्ति) of the Governor is mentioned in which Article?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Power. \n2. Logic: 72 President ke liye hai, 161 Governor ke liye. \n3. Limit: Governor 'Death Sentence' (fansi) ko puri tarah maaf nahi kar sakta, sirf rok sakta hai ya kam kar sakta hai.

qe: Who appoints the 'Chief Minister' of Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Appointment. \n2. Logic: Article 164 ke tehat Governor us vyakti ko CM banata hai jiske paas Vidhan Sabha mein 'Majority' (bahumat) ho. \n3. Fact: CM Governor ke 'Pleasure' tak pad par rehta hai.

qe: What is the 'Maximum Number' of ministers allowed in the Bihar Council of Ministers?
e: 1. Core Concept: 91st Amendment (2003). \n2. Logic: Total MLAs (Bihar mein 243) ka 15% se zyada mantri nahi ho sakte. \n3. Minimum: Kam se kam 12 mantri hone zaroori hain.

qe: The 'Ordinance Making Power' (अध्यादेश जारी करने की शक्ति) of the Governor is under?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative Power. \n2. Logic: 1-2-3 (President), 2-1-3 (Governor). \n3. Fact: Jab Vidhan Sabha session mein na ho, tab Governor temporary kanoon bana sakta hai.

qe: Which Article says 'There shall be a Council of Ministers to aid and advise the Governor'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Parliamentary System. \n2. Logic: Governor bina mantriyon ki salah ke zyadatar kamo mein faisla nahi leta. \n3. Exception: 'Discretionary powers' mein Governor bina salah ke bhi faisla le sakta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Advocate General' of a State appointed by?
e: 1. Core Concept: State Law Officer. \n2. Logic: Article 165 ke tehat ye Governor ki marzi tak pad par rehta hai. \n3. Qualification: Iska level High Court judge ke barabar hona chahiye.

qe: Can a person be appointed as 'Governor' for two or more states?
e: 1. Core Concept: 7th Amendment (1956). \n2. Logic: Ek hi Governor do states (jaise Bihar aur Jharkhand) ka kaam sambhal sakta hai. \n3. Salary: Is case mein salary dono states milkar dete hain.

qe: The 'Oath' (शपथ) to the Governor of Bihar is administered by?
o: Chief Justice of Patna High Court (पटना हाई कोर्ट के मुख्य न्यायाधीश)
e: 1. Core Concept: Oath Ceremony. \n2. Logic: Appointment President karta hai, par shapath us state ka Chief Justice dilata hai. \n3. Fact: Article 159 iska zikr karta hai.

qe: Article 167 defines the 'Duties' of?
e: 1. Core Concept: Communication. \n2. Logic: CM ka farz hai ki wo Governor ko sarkar ke saare faislo ki jankari de. \n3. Fact: Ye Governor aur Cabinet ke beech ka link hai.

qe: A Minister who is not a member of Bihar Legislature must become one within?
e: 1. Core Concept: Mandatory Membership. \n2. Logic: Bina MLA//MLC bane koi vyakti sirf 6 mahine tak hi mantri reh sakta hai. \n3. Fact: Agar wo election nahi jitta, toh use resign karna padega.

qe: Who is the 'Real Executive' head of the State?
e: 1. Distinction: Governor 'Nominal' (naam ke) head hain, par asli power CM ke paas hoti hai. \n2. Comparison: Jaise Centre mein PM hota hai, waise State mein CM.

qe: Under Article 200, the Governor can 'Reserve' a bill for?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative Check. \n2. Logic: Agar koi kanoon High Court ki power kam kar raha ho, toh Governor use President ke liye reserve kar leta hai. \n3. Fact: Ye Governor ki 'Discretionary' power hai.

qe: The 'Governor' holds office for a term of 5 years, subject to the pleasure of?
e: 1. Core Concept: Security of Tenure. \n2. Logic: Samvidhan mein Governor ko hatane ka koi 'Ground' nahi diya gaya hai. President jab chahe use bula sakta hai. \n3. Fact: Article 156 iska base hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Advocate General' for the State?
e: 1. Core Concept: Law Officer. \n2. Logic: 76 (Attorney General), 165 (Advocate General). \n3. Fact: Ye Bihar Vidhan Sabha mein baith sakta hai aur bol sakta hai.

qe: The 'Governor' acts as the 'Chancellor' of which universities in Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Academic Role. \n2. Logic: Bihar ke saare state-run universities (jaise PU, MU) ke head Governor hi hote hain. \n3. Fact: Central universities ka head 'President' hota hai.

qe: Who is the 'Link' between the Governor and the Council of Ministers?
e: 1. Core Concept: Communication Bridge. \n2. Logic: Cabinet ke har faisle ko Governor tak pahunchana CM ki zimmedari hai. \n3. Fact: Article 167 ye duty define karta hai.

qe: Under Article 164, 'Tribal Welfare Minister' is mandatory in which states?
e: 1. Core Concept: Tribal protection. \n2. Logic: Pehle Bihar isme shamil tha, par 94th Amendment (2006) ke baad Bihar ko is list se hata diya gaya. \n3. Note: Ab Jharkhand aur baaki 3 states isme hain.

qe: What is the minimum age to be appointed as the Governor of any State?
e: 1. Core Concept: Eligibility. \n2. Logic: President, Vice-President aur Governor teeno ke liye minimum age 35 saal hai. \n3. Fact: Ye rule poore India ke liye common hai.

qe: Article 164 states that the Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to:
e: 1. Core Concept: Parliamentary Accountability. \n2. Logic: Agar Vidhan Sabha 'No-Confidence Motion' pass karde, toh poori sarkar ko resign karna padega. \n3. Fact: Ye 'Collective Responsibility' ka principle hai.

qe: Who decides the salary and allowances of the Chief Minister and other ministers?
e: 1. Core Concept: State Autonomy. \n2. Logic: Har state ki Assembly khud tay karti hai ki unke CM aur Ministers ko kitni salary milegi. \n3. Fact: Isliye alag-alag states mein CM ki salary alag-alag hoti hai.

qe: Under Article 213, an Ordinance issued by the Governor must be approved by the State Legislature within?
e: 1. Core Concept: Ordinance Validity. \n2. Logic: Vidhan Sabha ke dubara baithne (re-assembly) ke 6 hafte ke andar ise pass karna zaroori hai, nahi toh ye radd ho jayega. \n3. Max Life: Ek ordinance ki maximum life 6 mahine aur 6 hafte ho sakti hai.

qe: Which Article defines the 'Discretionary Powers' (विवेकपूर्ण शक्तियां) of the Governor?
e: 1. Core Concept: Special Powers. \n2. Logic: 163 kehta hai ki Governor ko ministers ki advice leni hai, PAR jahan use lage ki khud faisla lena hai, wahan wo bina advice ke kaam kar sakta hai. \n3. Note: President ke paas aisi 'Explicit' constitutional discretionary power nahi hai.

qe: The 'Advocate General' of Bihar has the right to speak in:
e: 1. Core Concept: Rights of Law Officer. \n2. Logic: Article 177 ke tehat wo state ke dono houses aur kisi bhi committee ki proceedings mein bhag le sakta hai. \n3. Limit: Wo sirf 'Vote' nahi de sakta.

qe: Who acts as the 'Channel of Communication' between the Governor and the Cabinet?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 167. \n2. Logic: CM ka samvaidhanik kartavya hai ki wo Governor ko administrative aur legislative faislo ki jankari de.

qe: When a Bill is sent to the Governor, he can:
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 200. \n2. Logic: Governor ke paas 4 options hote hain- haan bolna, rok lena, vapas bhejna ya President ke liye reserve karna.

qe: Can the Governor pardon a 'Death Sentence' completely like the President?
e: 1. Core Concept: Pardon Limit. \n2. Logic: Article 161 ke tehat Governor fansi ki saza ko rok (Respite) sakta hai ya badal (Commute) sakta hai, par use 'Pardon' (puri tarah khatam) sirf President hi kar sakta hai.

qe: Who is the Chairman of the 'State Disaster Management Authority' (SDMA) in Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Statutory Head. \n2. Logic: Disaster Management Act 2005 ke tehat, state level par CM hi head hota hai. \n3. Fact: National level par head PM hota hai.

qe: Article 166 deals with:
o: Conduct of Business of Government of State (राज्य सरकार के कार्य का संचालन)
e: 1. Core Concept: Administrative Action. \n2. Logic: State sarkar ke saare executive kaam 'Governor' ke naam par kiye jate hain. \n3. Fact: Governor hi 'Rules of Business' banata hai.

qe: Who was the 'First Woman Chief Minister' of Bihar?
e: 1. Bihar Special: Rabri Devi Bihar ki pehli mahila CM bani thin. \n2. Fact: Wo teen baar is pad par rahin.

qe: Under the Constitution, the Governor is the 'Representative' of:
e: 1. Core Concept: Federal Link. \n2. Logic: Governor ek 'Dual Role' nibhata hai- ek toh state ka head aur dusra Centre ka agent//representative.

qe: Which Article provides that the Governor shall be 'Consulted' while appointing High Court judges?
e: 1. Core Concept: Judicial Appointment. \n2. Logic: President jab High Court ke judge ko appoint karta hai, toh wo CJI aur us state ke Governor se rai leta hai.

qe: The 'Contingency Fund of the State' is at the disposal of?
e: 1. Core Concept: Emergency Fund. \n2. Logic: Kisi bhi emergency kharche ke liye Governor is fund se paisa nikalne ki ijazat de sakta hai. \n3. Note: Centre mein ye power President ke paas hoti hai.

qe: Who has the power to 'Prorogue' (सत्रावसान) the sessions of the State Legislature?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative Powers. \n2. Logic: Assembly ko bulana (Summon) aur session khatam karna (Prorogue) dono kaam Governor ke hain. \n3. Fact: Din-bhar ki meeting ko postpone karna (Adjourn) 'Speaker' ka kaam hai.

qe: Under Article 164, who can be 'Dismissed' by the Governor at any time?
o: Any individual Minister (कोई भी व्यक्तिगत मंत्री)
e: 1. Core Concept: Individual Responsibility. \n2. Logic: Mantri Governor ke 'Pleasure' tak pad par rehte hain. Agar CM kisi mantri ko hatana chahe, toh Governor use hata sakta hai.

qe: In Bihar, if a Money Bill is passed, who gives the final assent?
e: 1. Core Concept: Assent to Bills. \n2. Logic: Normal bills ki tarah Money bill par bhi Governor ki sign zaroori hai. \n3. Fact: Governor Money bill ko 'Reconsideration' ke liye vapas nahi bhej sakta.

qe: Who appoints the 'State Election Commissioner' (SEC)?
e: 1. Core Concept: Local Bodies. \n2. Logic: Article 243K ke tehat Governor hi SEC ko appoint karta hai. \n3. Fact: SEC Panchayato aur Municipalities ke election karwata hai.

qe: Which Article specifies that the Governor 'Shall not hold any other office of profit'?
e: 1. Core Concept: Conditions of Office. \n2. Logic: Governor rehte hue wo koi sarkari naukri ya private business nahi kar sakta. \n3. Fact: Use muft niwas (Raj Bhavan) milta hai.

qe: Who is the 'Highest Law Officer' in the state of Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 165. \n2. Logic: Advocate General hi sarkar ka sabse bada vakeel hai jo kanooni salah deta hai.

qe: Can the 'Governor' nominate members to the State Legislative Council (Bihar)?
o: Yes, 1//6th of total members (हाँ, कुल सदस्यों का 1//6)
e: 1. Core Concept: Nominations. \n2. Logic: Art, Science, Literature, Social Service aur Co-operative movement ke experts ko Governor nominate karta hai. \n3. Bihar Context: Bihar mein Vidhan Parishad hai, isliye ye power yahan use hoti hai.

qe: Who appoints the 'District Judges' in Bihar?
o: The Governor in consultation with High Court (HC के परामर्श से राज्यपाल)
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 233. \n2. Logic: District level ki appointments Governor hi karta hai par High Court se puch kar.

qe: What happens if the Governor of Bihar dies in office?
o: Chief Justice of HC may act as Governor (HC के मुख्य न्यायाधीश कार्यभार संभाल सकते हैं)
e: 1. Core Concept: Contingency. \n2. Logic: Article 160 ke tehat President temporary arrangement karta hai, zyadatar HC ke CJ ko ye zimmedari di jati hai.

qe: The 'Council of Ministers' size was limited to 15% by which amendment?
e: 1. Core Concept: Anti-Defection related. \n2. Logic: 2003 mein ye limit lagayi gayi taaki bahut saare mantri banakar lalach na diya jaye.

qe: Who is the 'Executive Head' of the state government?
e: 1. Core Concept: De-jure Head. \n2. Logic: Samvidhan ne saari executive powers Governor ko di hain. \n3. Distinction: Wo head hai, par powers 'Council of Ministers' ki help se use karta hai.

qe: In which case can the Governor act 'Without Advice' of the Council of Ministers?
o: Appointment of CM when no party has majority (बहुमत न होने पर CM की नियुक्ति)
e: 1. Core Concept: Discretionary Powers. \n2. Logic: In teeno halato mein Governor ko apne 'Vivek' (vivek-shakti) ka istemal karna hota hai.

qe: The 'Governor' is an integral part of?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative Structure. \n2. Logic: Jaise Parliament President+LS+RS se banti hai, waise hi State Legislature Governor+Assembly(+Council) se banti hai.

qe: Who administers the oath to the Chief Minister of Bihar?
e: 1. Core Concept: Appointment of Executive. \n2. Logic: Governor hi CM aur baaki saare Ministers ko unke pad aur gopniyata (secrecy) ki shapath dilata hai.

qe: Under which Article can the Governor send a 'Report' to the President for the failure of constitutional machinery?
e: 1. Core Concept: President's Rule. \n2. Logic: Jab Governor ko lage ki State Govt Samvidhan ke hisab se nahi chal rahi, toh wo Art 356 lagane ki sifaarish karta hai. \n3. Fact: Bihar mein pehli baar President's Rule 1968 mein laga tha.

qe: The 'Governor' has the power to address and send messages to the State Legislature under?
e: 1. Core Concept: Legislative Communication. \n2. Logic: Governor kisi pending bill par ya kisi zaroori mudde par Assembly ko message bhej sakta hai. \n3. Fact: Ye Governor ki ek mukhya 'Legislative Power' hai.

qe: Who is the 'Ex-officio' Chairman of the Bihar Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad)?
o: Chairman elected by the Council (परिषद द्वारा चुना गया सभापति)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Jaise Rajya Sabha mein VP hota hai, waise Vidhan Parishad mein 'Chairman' (सभापति) sadasyo ke beech se hi chuna jata hai. \n2. Note: Governor iska member nahi hota.

qe: Can the Governor 'Dissolve' the Bihar Vidhan Parishad?
o: No, it is a permanent body (नहीं, यह एक स्थायी निकाय है)
e: 1. Core Concept: Nature of House. \n2. Logic: Vidhan Parishad kabhi bhang nahi hoti. Har 2 saal mein 1//3 sadasya retire hote hain. \n3. Fact: Governor sirf Vidhan 'Sabha' ko bhang kar sakta hai.

qe: Under Article 164, the Chief Minister shall hold office during the:
o: Pleasure of the Governor (राज्यपाल के प्रसाद-पर्यंत)
e: 1. Smart Catch: Halanki CM 5 saal ke liye banta hai, par kanoonan wo Governor ki marzi (pleasure) tak rehta hai. \n2. Practicality: Jab tak CM ke paas Assembly mein majority hai, Governor use nahi hata sakta.

qe: Who is the only authority that can 'Transfer' a High Court Judge?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Governor sirf consult hota hai, asli power President ke paas hai (CJI se pucho ke baad). \n2. Article: Article 222 transfers se deal karta hai.

qe: The 'Rules of Business' of Bihar Government are made by?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 166. \n2. Logic: Saare mantriyo ko kaam kaise baantna hai (Allocation of Portfolios), ye rules Governor ke naam par bante hain. \n3. Practice: Asal mein CM hi ye tay karta hai.

qe: Which Article provides for 'Special Address' by the Governor at the start of first session each year?
e: 1. Core Concept: Opening Session. \n2. Logic: Har saal ke pehle session mein aur har naye election ke baad Governor address karta hai. \n3. Content: Ye bhashan (speech) sarkar ki policies ko dikhata hai.

qe: Can the Governor of Bihar act as an 'Acting President' of India?
e: 1. Logic: President ke baad VP, aur VP ke baad CJI Acting President bante hain. \n2. Distinction: Governor kabhi President nahi banta jab tak uska selection us pad ke liye na ho.

qe: Who was the 'Longest Serving' Chief Minister of Bihar? (Till April 2026 context)
e: 1. Bihar Record: Nitish Kumar ne Sri Krishna Singh ke record ko piche chhod diya hai. \n2. Fact: Wo sabse zyada baar shapath lene wale CM bhi hain.

qe: Under Article 213, who can 'Withdraw' an Ordinance at any time?
e: 1. Power: Jisne ordinance laya, wahi use kabhi bhi wapas le sakta hai. \n2. Condition: Iske liye use cabinet ki advice chahiye hogi.

qe: The 'Advocate General' of Bihar holds office during the pleasure of?
e: 1. Article: 165(3). \n2. Logic: Chunki wo state ka officer hai, isliye Governor hi use jab chahe hata sakta hai. \n3. Fact: Attorney General President ke pleasure tak rehta hai.

qe: The 'Governor' can reserve a Bill for President's consideration. Which Article is this?
e: 1. Hook: 200 mein reserve kiya jata hai, aur 201 mein President uspar action leta hai. \n2. Hustle: Student aksar 200 aur 201 mein confuse hote hain.

qe: Who appoints the 'Members' of the Bihar State Finance Commission?
e: 1. Article: 243-I. \n2. Logic: State Finance Commission local bodies ke liye banta hai aur iski saari appointments Governor karta hai.

qe: If Bihar Vidhan Sabha passes a bill AGAIN after Governor returned it, can he return it again?
o: No, he must give assent (नहीं, उसे अनुमति देनी ही होगी)
e: 1. Core Concept: Suspensive Veto. \n2. Logic: Governor sirf ek baar bill wapas bhej sakta hai. Dusri baar use sign karna hi padega.

qe: The 'Governor' is a 'Nominated' head, but India's President is 'Elected'. Why?
o: To maintain unity and Central control (एकता और केंद्रीय नियंत्रण बनाए रखने के लिए)
e: 1. Federal Logic: Agar Governor bhi elected hota, toh CM aur usme hamesha ladayi hoti. \n2. Role: Governor Centre aur State ke beech bridge ki tarah kaam karta hai.

qe: Who acts as the Chairman of the 'State Planning Board' in Bihar?
e: 1. Executive Post: Jaise Centre mein NITI Aayog ka head PM hai, waise hi State level planning ka head CM hota hai.

qe: What is the maximum 'Time Gap' between two sessions of Bihar Legislature?
e: 1. Article: 174. \n2. Rule: Do sessions ke beech 6 mahine se zyada gap nahi hona chahiye. \n3. Logic: Saal mein kam se kam 2 baar milna mandatory hai.

qe: The 'Governor' can appoint a minister from?
e: 1. Rule: Bihar mein dono Houses hain, isliye mantri dono mein se kisi ka bhi sadasya ho sakta hai. \n2. Fact: Agar wo member nahi hai, toh 6 mahine ka time milta hai.

qe: Which Article provides that the Governor shall be 'immune' from civil and criminal proceedings?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Jab tak Governor pad par hai, unpar koi criminal case nahi chal sakta aur na hi unhe arrest kiya ja sakta hai.

qe: Under Article 164, the Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to?
e: 1. Concept: Democratic check. \n2. Logic: Unhe Assembly ka bharosa (confidence) chahiye hota hai, Vidhan Parishad ka nahi.

qe: Who was the 'First Chief Minister' of Bihar?
e: 1. Bihar History: Unhe 'Bihar Kesari' bhi kaha jata hai. \n2. Fact: Wo 1946 se 1961 tak CM rahe the.

qe: Can the Governor 'Reduce' a death sentence without pardoning it?
e: 1. Technical Point: Governor fansi ko 'Commute' (badal) sakta hai (jaise fansi ko umra-kaid mein badalna). \n2. Restriction: Wo use poori tarah zero nahi kar sakta.

qe: The 'Contingency Fund of Bihar' is operated by?
e: 1. Fund Management: Emergency fund Governor ke hath mein hota hai. \n2. Note: Consolidated fund se paisa nikalne ke liye Vidhan Sabha ki ijazat chahiye hoti hai.

qe: Who decides the 'Language' to be used in Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
e: 1. Article: 210. \n2. Logic: Samvidhan Assembly ko ye power deta hai ki wo Hindi, English ya regional bhasha chunein.

qe: The 'Governor' can address the Legislature on its first session. Is it mandatory?
e: 1. Rule: Article 176 ke tehat ye 'Special Address' compulsory hota hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Appointment' of Chief Minister of Bihar?
e: 1. Concept: Appointment chain. \n2. Logic: 164 kehta hai ki CM Governor dwara appoint hoga aur baaki mantri CM ki sifaarish par.

qe: Who among the following was the 'First Dalit CM' of Bihar?
e: 1. Bihar History: Bhola Paswan Shastri pehle Dalit CM bane the. \n2. Fact: Unhe 'Bihar ka Gandhi' bhi kaha jata tha unki saadgi ke liye.

qe: Can the 'Governor' act as the Governor of a Union Territory?
e: 1. Rule: President kisi bhi state ke Governor ko padosi UT ka 'Administrator' bana sakta hai.

qe: Under Article 166, all executive actions of the Government of Bihar shall be expressed to be taken in the name of?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Sarkar ka har order, har scheme Governor ke naam par nikalti hai. \n2. Technical Fact: Governor hi 'Rules of Business' banata hai ki mantriyo ko kaam kaise milega.

qe: The 'Discretionary Powers' (विवेकपूर्ण शक्तियां) of the Governor are wider than the President. Why?
o: The Constitution explicitly mentions them for Governor (संविधान में राज्यपाल के लिए इनका स्पष्ट उल्लेख है)
e: 1. Hook: Article 163 explicitly kehta hai ki Governor 'Discretion' use kar sakta hai. \n2. Comparison: President ko 42nd//44th amendment ne Cabinet ki baat maanne ke liye majboor kiya hai, par Governor ke paas Samvidhan mein hi ye 'Space' di gayi hai.

qe: Who acts as the 'Legal Advisor' to the Government of Bihar in the High Court?
e: 1. Logic: State level par Advocate General (Art 165) hi sabse bada lawyer hota hai. \n2. Fact: Use wahi salary aur allowances milte hain jo Governor tay kare.

qe: Article 167 makes it 'Obligatory' for the CM to provide information to Governor. What if CM refuses?
o: It is a Constitutional Violation (यह एक संवैधानिक उल्लंघन है)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Agar CM information nahi deta, toh ise 'Failure of Constitutional Machinery' mana ja sakta hai. \n2. Power: Is ground par Governor President's Rule (Art 356) ki sifaarish kar sakta hai.

qe: Can the Governor 'Nominate' a member to the Bihar Vidhan Sabha (Assembly) today?
o: No, abolished by 104th Amendment (नहीं, 104वें संशोधन द्वारा समाप्त)
e: 1. Smart Catch: Pehle Article 333 ke tehat 1 Anglo-Indian nominate hota tha. \n2. Update: 2020 mein 104th Amendment ne ise khatam kar diya. Ab Vidhan Sabha ke saare sadasya elected hote hain.

qe: What happens to the 'Council of Ministers' if the Chief Minister resigns or dies?
o: It is automatically dissolved (यह स्वतः ही भंग हो जाती है)
e: 1. Logic: CM poori team ka 'Captain' hota hai. Captain gaya toh team khatam. \n2. Difference: Agar koi normal mantri mare toh sirf ek vacancy hoti hai, par CM ke jane se poori sarkar gir jati hai.

qe: The 'Advocate General' of Bihar can be a member of any committee of the State Legislature.
e: 1. Article: 177. \n2. Power: Wo committees mein baith sakta hai, bol sakta hai aur member ban sakta hai. \n3. Limit: Sirf 'Vote' nahi de sakta.

qe: Article 213 (Ordinance) power is used by the Governor on the advice of?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Ye Governor ki 'Legislative' power hai par ye 'Discretionary' nahi hai. \n2. Rule: CM aur Cabinet jab kahenge, tabhi ordinance laya jayega.

qe: If there is a dispute regarding the 'Age' of a High Court judge, who decides it?
o: The President after consulting CJI (CJI से परामर्श के बाद राष्ट्रपति)
e: 1. Technical Point: High Court ke judges ki age par final faisla President ka hota hai. \n2. Role of Governor: Governor ka isme koi faisla lene ka haq nahi hai.

qe: The 'Governor' can be removed by the President. Is the reason for removal mentioned in the Constitution?
o: No, it is not mentioned (नहीं, इसका उल्लेख नहीं है)
e: 1. Hook: Ye sabse badi 'Hustle' hai. Governor ko hatane ka koi ground Samvidhan mein nahi likha. \n2. Fact: Wo sirf 'Pleasure of President' (Art 156) par tika hota hai.

qe: Under Article 161, the Governor can grant pardons in cases related to?
o: State Laws only (केवल राज्य के कानूनों से संबंधित)
e: 1. Logic: Governor ki power sirf unhi subjects par hai jinpar State kanoon bana sakta hai (State List). \n2. Limit: Court Martial (Military) aur Death Sentence par Governor ka 'Pardon' nahi chalta.

qe: Who is the 'Head' of the State Cabinet in Bihar?
e: 1. Distinction: State ka head Governor hai, par 'Sarkar' (Cabinet) ka head CM hota hai. \n2. Power: CM hi tay karta hai ki meeting kab hogi aur kya agenda hoga.

qe: Can a person who is not a citizen of India be appointed as a Governor?
e: 1. Condition: Article 157 kehta hai ki 'Citizen of India' hona pehli shart hai. \n2. Second condition: 35 saal ki age poori honi chahiye.

qe: The 'Salary' of the Advocate General of Bihar is determined by?
e: 1. Logic: Article 165(3) kehta hai ki unhe wo 'Remuneration' milega jo Governor tay karega. \n2. Fact: Ye mantriyon ki tarah Assembly tay nahi karti.

qe: Under Article 163, if a question arises whether a matter is in Governor's 'Discretion' or not, who's decision is final?
e: 1. Hustle: Ye ek 'Super Power' hai. Governor khud decide karta hai ki ye mera discretion hai ya nahi, aur use kisi court mein challenge nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: The 'Governor' has the power to appoint which of the following in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: State level ki saari top statutory aur constitutional appointments Governor hi karta hai.

qe: Who advises the Governor on the 'Disqualification' of a member of Bihar Vidhan Sabha?
o: Election Commission of India (भारत का निर्वाचन आयोग)
e: 1. Article: 192. \n2. Process: Election Commission ki rai Governor ke liye 'Binding' (manne layak) hoti hai. \n3. Exception: Dal-badal (Anti-defection) ke liye 'Speaker' decide karta hai.

qe: The 'Governor' can reserve a Bill for President. Does the President have to sign it within a time limit?
o: No, no time limit mentioned (नहीं, कोई समय सीमा नहीं है)
e: 1. Pocket Veto: Article 201 mein President ke liye koi time limit nahi hai. Wo use 'Anant kaal' (infinite time) ke liye apne paas rakh sakta hai.

qe: Under Article 167, the CM must inform Governor about 'Legislative proposals'. What does it include?
o: All administrative decisions and bills (सभी प्रशासनिक निर्णय और विधेयक)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Governor ko 'Dark' mein nahi rakha ja sakta. Samvidhan use poora haq deta hai ki wo jane ki sarkar kya kar rahi hai.

qe: Can the 'Governor' of Bihar remove the Chairman of Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC)?
o: No, only the President can (नहीं, केवल राष्ट्रपति हटा सकते हैं)
e: 1. Hook: Appointment Governor karta hai (Art 316), par REMOVAL sirf President karta hai (Art 317). \n2. Reason: Taaki BPSC par State sarkar ka dawab na rahe.

qe: The 'Council of Ministers' in Bihar is headed by the Chief Minister. Who presides over its meetings?
e: 1. Rule: Cabinet ki meetings mein Governor nahi baithta. CM hi unka boss hota hai.

qe: Which Article allows the Governor to 'Summon' (बुलाना) the Houses of State Legislature?
e: 1. Power: Assembly ko session ke liye bulana Governor ka kaam hai. \n2. Rule: Do sessions ke beech 6 mahine se zyada gap nahi hona chahiye.

qe: The 'Advocate General' of a state can participate in Parliamentary proceedings?
o: No, only in State Legislature (नहीं, केवल राज्य विधानमंडल में)
e: 1. Jurisdiction: AG sirf apne state ki Vidhan Sabha//Parishad tak limited hai. \n2. Fact: Centre ke liye Attorney General hota hai.

qe: Under Article 164, the Governor appoints a Minister on the advice of?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Governor khud se kisi ko mantri nahi bana sakta. Use CM ki di hui list hi follow karni padti hai.

qe: Does the Governor have any 'Military' or 'Diplomatic' powers like the President?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Army aur Foreign affairs Centre ke paas hote hain. Isliye Governor ke paas aisi koi power nahi hoti.

qe: Who decides the 'Rules of Authentication' of executive orders in Bihar?
e: 1. Article: 166(2). \n2. Fact: Orders kaise sign honge aur kaun karega, ye Governor ke rules se chalta hai.

qe: Can the Governor of Bihar 'Nominate' members to the Vidhan Parishad in Bihar?
e: 1. Logic: Bihar mein 'Bicameral' (do house) system hai. \n2. Fields: Literature, Science, Art, Co-operative movement aur Social Service.

qe: If Bihar Government loses its 'Majority' in Vidhan Sabha, does the CM have to resign?
e: 1. Logic: Collective Responsibility ke tehat bina majority ke sarkar nahi chal sakti. \n2. Action: Agar wo resign nahi karta, toh Governor use 'Dismiss' kar sakta hai.

qe: The 'Executive Power' of the State is vested in Governor under which Article?
e: 1. Core Concept: Article 154 hi Governor ko state ka 'Executive Head' banata hai.

qe: Who was the 'First Governor of Bihar' during the British era (1920)?
o: Sir Satyendra Prasanna Sinha (सर सत्येंद्र प्रसन्न सिन्हा)
e: 1. Bihar History: Lord Sinha pehle Indian Governor the kisi bhi province ke British time mein.

qe: The Governor's 'Discretionary Power' is NOT subject to judicial review. Under which Article is this protected?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: 163(2) kehta hai ki agar koi sawal uthe ki maamla Governor ke vivek mein hai ya nahi, toh Governor ka faisla final hoga. \n2. Hustle: Kisi bhi court mein ye pucha nahi ja sakta ki unhone aisa faisla kyun liya.

qe: Can the Governor 'Reserve' a Money Bill for the President?
o: Yes, in certain conditions (हाँ, कुछ विशेष स्थितियों में)
e: 1. Smart Catch: Zyadatar log 'No' bolte hain kyunki Governor Money bill vapas nahi bhej sakta. \n2. Post-Mortem: Par Article 200 use 'Reserve' karne ki power deta hai agar wo bill Federal system ya High Court ko affect kare.

qe: Who decides if a matter falls under the 'Discretion' of the Governor?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Ye Governor ki sabse badi 'Hidden Power' hai. Samvidhan use khud apna judge banata hai ki ye maamla uske vivek mein hai ya nahi.

qe: Under Article 201, when a bill is reserved for President, the Governor's role is:
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Ek baar bill President ke paas chala gaya, toh Governor ka role khatam. Ab President seedha Assembly se deal karega. \n2. Difference: Ye normal bills se alag hai jahan Governor bich mein hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Maximum Duration' for which the Governor can remain in office?
o: No limit, until President's pleasure (कोई सीमा नहीं, राष्ट्रपति के प्रसाद-पर्यंत)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 5 saal sirf ek 'Normal term' hai. Samvidhan mein koi retirement age ya limit nahi hai. \n2. Hustle: Jab tak President chahe (Pleasure), ek hi insaan saalo tak Governor reh sakta hai.

qe: If a Governor is transferred from Bihar to UP, who pays his salary for that month?
o: Both sharing as per President's order (राष्ट्रपति के आदेशानुसार दोनों साझा करेंगे)
e: 1. Article: 158(3A). \n2. Post-Mortem: Jab ek Governor do states sambhalta hai ya bich mahine mein transfer hota hai, toh President tay karta hai ki kaun sa state kitna paisa dega.

qe: Can the Governor summon the Vidhan Sabha against the wishes of the CM?
o: Yes, if he believes CM has lost majority (हाँ, यदि उसे लगे कि CM ने बहुमत खो दिया है)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Normal halat mein advice manni hogi, par 'Floor Test' ke liye Governor bina advice ke bhi house bula sakta hai (Nabam Rebia Case logic).

qe: The 'Advocate General' of Bihar can be removed by?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Inka removal bahut simple hai. Governor jab chahe bina kisi inquiry ke hata sakta hai. \n2. Hustle: Isliye ye 'Independent' body nahi, balki 'Political appointee' mane jate hain.

qe: Article 167(c) allows Governor to require a decision of an individual Minister to be considered by?
o: The Council of Ministers (पूरे मंत्री परिषद द्वारा)
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: Agar koi mantri akela koi bada faisla le le jisme Cabinet shamil na ho, toh Governor keh sakta hai ki 'Poori team ko baithao aur fir faisla karo'.

qe: The Governor's ordinance has the same force as an Act of Legislature. True or False?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Jab tak ye valid hai, iski kanooni value wahi hai jo Vidhan Sabha ke kanoon ki hoti hai. \n2. Limit: Par ye 'Temporary' hota hai (Max 6 months + 6 weeks).

qe: Who was the 'First Acting Governor' of Bihar?
e: 1. Bihar History: 1971 mein Justice U.N. Sinha ne ye zimmedari nibhayi thi. \n2. Logic: Jab Governor ka pad khali ho, toh High Court ke CJ ko 'Acting Governor' banaya jata hai.

qe: Can the Governor pardon a sentence of 'Court Martial' (Military Court)?
e: 1. Post-Mortem Difference: Pardoning power mein President aur Governor ke beech do bade antar hain- 1. Fansi (Death Sentence) 2. Court Martial. In dono par sirf President chalta hai.

qe: Under Article 166(3), who makes rules for more convenient transaction of government business?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Bihar Govt ke andar kaun si file kis mantri ke paas jayegi, ye rules Governor ke naam par bante hain. \n2. Hustle: Isse 'Rules of Executive Business' kehte hain.

qe: The 'Governor' is immune from 'Civil Proceedings' during his term except with?
o: After 2 months notice (2 महीने के नोटिस के बाद)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Criminal case toh chal hi nahi sakta, par civil case (jaise zameen vivad) ke liye 2 mahine ka notice dena mandatory hai.

qe: Which Article provides for the 'Immunity' of the Governor from being answerable to any court?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Governor ne pad par rehte hue jo bhi kaam kiya, uske liye koi bhi court unhe summon nahi kar sakta. \n2. Logic: Wo apni constitutional duties ke liye 'Immune' hain.

qe: The 'State Council of Ministers' size is 15%. Does it include the Chief Minister?
o: Only if CM is from Vidhan Sabha
e: 1. Post-Mortem Logic: CM + Ministers = Max 15% of total MLAs. \n2. Fact: Bihar mein 243 seats hain, toh mantriyon ki ginti CM ko milakar 36-37 se zyada nahi honi chahiye.

qe: Who was the 'First Governor of Bihar' to be appointed as Vice-President of India?
e: 1. Bihar History: Zakir Hussain Bihar ke Governor the (1957-62) aur baad mein desh ke VP aur phir President bane.

qe: Can the Governor 'Return' a bill to the Bihar Vidhan Parishad for reconsideration?
o: No, only to Vidhan Sabha (नहीं, केवल विधानसभा को)
e: 1. Post-Mortem: Agar bill dono houses se pass hua hai, toh Governor use 'Legislative Assembly' (Vidhan Sabha) ko hi vapas bhejta hai reconsideration ke liye.

qe: What is the 'Minimum' number of ministers (including CM) mandatory in Bihar?
e: 1. Post-Mortem: 91st Amendment kehta hai ki 15% max hai, par 12 mantri hone 'Minimum' mandatory hain taaki sarkar chal sake.

qe: Does the Constitution provide any 'Method' for the removal of a Governor?
o: No specific method provided (कोई विशिष्ट विधि नहीं दी गई है)
e: 1. Ultimate Post-Mortem: Samvidhan ispar bilkul 'Chup' (Silent) hai. President jab chahe, use hata sakta hai. Isliye ise 'Pleasure of President' kaha jata hai.

qe: What is the 'Annual Financial Statement' of the State presented before?
e: 1. Budget Logic: Article 202 ke tehat Governor ise Assembly ke samne rakhwata hai. \n2. Fact: Finance Minister ise Governor ki taraf se pesh karta hai.

qe: Which Article provides that there shall be a Governor for each state?
e: 1. Core Concept: Mandatory Office. \n2. Logic: Article 153 se hi Governor ke pad ki shuruat hoti hai.

qe: Can the 'Governor' be a member of either House of Parliament?
e: 1. Core Concept: Qualifications. \n2. Logic: Agar koi MP ya MLA Governor banta hai, toh use apni purani seat usi din chhodni padti hai. \n3. Age: Governor banne ke liye kam se kam 35 saal ki age honi chahiye.
